title: Caliban Node spec (v0)
description: A node is a versioned, declarative AI sub-app. See docs/research/04-agent-orchestration.md §1.

input_schema.description: Validated against the run input (JSON Schema subset, see crates/caliban-nodes/src/schema.rs)

output_schema.description: Validated against the run output (JSON Schema subset)

model.description: Model id (or caliban/auto) the node's calls ask for; default: the first candidate that is a model id, else caliban/auto

reasoning.description: Default reasoning effort of the node's model calls (a vertex's config.reasoning overrides it); mapped per model family by the gateway

ref.description: mcp://server/tool#sha256:<hash> (an approved manifest), node://name@vN, builtin://datasource_query or builtin://rag_search

allow_tainted.description: writes, and reads that reach the network through their arguments: taint labels the arguments may carry without a human approval (tool:<server>/*, datasource, caller, *)

scopes.description: <datasource>.<object or *>:<read|write> for datasources; rag.<collection or *>:read for document collections (builtin://rag_search)

answer.description: The answer guard on the run's final output when it carries untrusted labels: links, contacts and references that only untrusted free text supplied, and echoes of injected instructions, are removed (redact) or fail the run (refuse).

pii.description: A floor on the personal-data protection of the node's model calls, on every model class (sovereign models included), and of untrusted tool arguments and results. Only strengthens the tenant's mode.

agent.description: Only for kind=agent: the bounded tool loop.

usd.description: Most one run may spend on model calls (USD, priced like the metering)

max_repeats.description: Loop guard: the same vertex with the same input at most this many times

tool_retries.description: Retries of a tool call that failed transiently

graph.description: Only for kind=workflow. Vertices + edges; loops must declare max_iterations. See docs/nodes.md for each vertex type's config.

entry.description: The vertex a run starts at (default: the first)

type.description: code is not yet supported (refused at publish)

config.description: Per vertex type (docs/nodes.md). Model vertices (llm, router, verify, reduce with mode llm) also take reasoning and structured_output.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort of this vertex's model call, mapped per model family by the gateway (Qwen3 enable_thinking, reasoning_effort); overrides model_policy.reasoning

structured_output.description: With an output_schema (llm, reduce) and for router labels: json_schema asks the server for constrained decoding (response_format json_schema; vLLM and SGLang guided decoding, OpenAI structured outputs); prompt puts the schema in the prompt only. The answer is validated either way.
